headline: Approved second read of Tobacco Prohibition policy B7; first reads of student drugs and alcohol and home study policies continued.
summary: Management said estimates for the Spark Center project came back too high, so new options will return later. The meeting also covered a draft charter for the Merger Buddies initiative and a student report on an AI conference. Tobacco policy B7 was approved, and several reports were accepted, all unanimously.
decisions: Approved the Consent Agenda, which included meeting minutes, bill approvals, and Policy 2.7, passed unanimously.
Approved second read of policy B7 Tobacco Prohibition, passed unanimously.
Continued first read of policy C2 Student Drugs & Alcohol to the next meeting.
Continued first read of policy C6 Home Study Students, with second read at the next meeting.
Accepted the internal monitoring report on Policy 4.8, passed unanimously.
Accepted the internal monitoring report on Policy 4.9 Board Committee Principles, passed unanimously.
Accepted the internal monitoring report on Policy 2.1, passed unanimously.
Accepted the September 2026 Superintendent’s Report, passed unanimously.

Robert Millar looks for a motion to accept the Internal Monitoring Report Policy 4.8... Katie Livermore - “So Moved.” Passed Unanimously.
Robert Millar looks for a motion to accept the Internal Monitoring Report on Policy 4.9 Board Committee Principles... Passed Unanimously.
Robert Millar looks for a motion to accept Wilmer’s Internal Monitoring Report on Policy 2.1... Passed Unanimously.
Robert Millar looks for a motion to accept Wilmer’s September 2026 Superintendent’s Report to the Board... Passed Unanimously.
